notes.title: We're Live!
notes.notes:
2048 is now finally available on Steam!

To celebrate the launch, we're running a 10% launch discount for the first week. Get it while it's hot!

If you didn't already know, here is a bit about what the game is about;
2048 is a classic puzzle with a simple goal; reach 2048.
Move your tiles across the grid and merge identical numbers into one. Plan ahead and watch out for new tiles spawning, that may prevent you from joining your numbers. Play on different board sizes and compete with people from all over the world, for your place on the leaderboards.

Build upon the original 2048, this new version expands the gameplay further with multiple board sizes, game modes, achievements, leaderboards, a night mode, cloud saves, and more!

notes.title: Closed Beta
notes.notes:
We're fast approaching version 1.0 and with that, our release!
To make sure the game runs smoothly across all platforms and hardware, we're having a closed beta in the coming weeks. If you're interested in becoming a beta tester, you can fill out the form [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSed44AtuW-Sp9_J6lVqEnVyZIMcMTb4mAaWuVoutFxBQ2SOaA/viewform]right here[/url]. As a "thank you" for your help, the game is yours to keep, even after the beta ends and the game is released.

While we probably can't cram any more features into the v.1.0 release, we would still love to hear from this community going forward.
[b]Tell us your thoughts, make a feature wish, or ask a question![/b]
